title: Cartan calculus in tangent categories
summary: We determine the structure needed in a tangent category in the sense of Rosický and Cockett-Cruttwell to construct the Cartan calculus on all objects. The missing ingredient is a scalar multiplication by a commutative ring object $R$, playing the role of the smooth real line, which equips the tangent bundle of every object with the structure of an $R$-module compatible with the tangent structure.
